summary: Tested all 4 new ERP modules end-to-end (imports, documents, predict/pricing, multi-boutiques). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases PASS in 9.94s including AI pricing (Emergent LLM) and CSV price-computation logic. Frontend: admin login OK, all 4 new tabs render without console errors, store creation via UI succeeds with success toast, predict-total + 16 pricing-apply buttons + doc-upload-btn all present. No blocking issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid on Name/Domaine/Tagline text inputs — tests fell back to nth(0) input. Adding testids like store-name-input would improve testability.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="store-name-input" (and domain/tagline) on the store form <In/> inputs for more robust E2E tests.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py _localize_images: downloaded image extension is decided only by presence of 'png' in content-type; svg/webp fall back to .jpg. Minor.
documents.py: STORAGE_DIR under /app/backend/storage is fine but not persisted through container rebuilds — consider a mounted volume in prod.

predict.py apply_price: requires 'catalog' area while pricing/forecast require 'analytics' — a marketing role that has analytics but not catalog can view suggestions but not apply. Confirm this is intended.
stores.py public_store: enriches with cj/marketing (flash sales). If marketing module import fails silently, no logging — a debug log would help troubleshooting.
Admin.jsx StoresTab form uses shared <In/> component with no testids on inner inputs; add for testability.
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up in tests) 1 store TEST_Boutique_Alpha + 1 document TEST_Contract_A. Also imported 2-3 TEST_Prod_* products via CSV that remain (per instructions, main agent will clean). Frontend test also created a store 'TEST_Boutique_UI' (slug test-boutique-ui) that remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New modules are stable. CSV import price-computation (empty price + buy_price * margin) verified: 15 * 1.6 = 24.0 asserted. AI pricing endpoint tolerated 502 fallback but returned 200 with recommended_price. Public store endpoint /api/public/stores/{slug} returns 200 without auth. RBAC: unauthenticated calls return 401/403. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_new_modules.py is idempotent (uses unique names / cleans docs & stores).
